question.html:
A spacetime diagram has the same scale on both axes. Three statements about a photon that travels in vacuum and starts at the origin of the spacetime diagram are

I. The angle between the worldline of the photon and both axes is .

II. The worldline of the photon is a straight line.

III. The speed of the photon as measured by a stationary observer in the reference frame of the spacetime diagram depends on the speed of the reference frame.

Which of the statements are correct?

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
